# vyos.blueprints.ha_vrrp

VRRP high-availability pair (docs blueprint "High Availability Walkthrough")

- Configures VRRP groups, an optional sync-group and optional conntrack-sync on each member of a two-node HA pair.
- Put shared settings (`ha_vrrp_groups`, `ha_vrrp_sync_group`, `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync`) in the pair's group_vars and per-node settings (`ha_vrrp_priority`, `ha_vrrp_local_addresses`) in host_vars.
- Unicast peers are taken from `ha_vrrp_peer_addresses`, or derived from the other host in `ha_vrrp_pair_group`. Without either, VRRP uses multicast.
- Interfaces and their real addresses are not configured here; use `vyos.blueprints.base` first.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.ha_vrrp
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_vrrp_groups` | list | yes |  | VRRP groups, identical on both nodes. |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.name` | str | yes |  | Group name. |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.vrid` | int | yes |  | Virtual router ID (1-255). |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.interface` | str | yes |  | Interface the group runs on, e.g. `eth1.201`. |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.address` | list | yes |  | Virtual address(es) in CIDR notation. |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.no_preempt` | bool |  | `true` | Do not take mastership back after recovery (the blueprint default). |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.advertise_interval` | int |  |  | Advertisement interval in seconds. |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.description` | str |  |  | Group description. |
| `ha_vrrp_groups.track_interfaces` | list |  |  | Interfaces whose failure lowers this node to backup. |
| `ha_vrrp_priority` | int | yes |  | This node's priority (higher wins), applied to every group. |
| `ha_vrrp_local_addresses` | dict |  | `{}` | Map of group name to this node's own address on that group's interface (no prefix length). Used as hello-source-address and, with `ha_vrrp_pair_group`, as the peer address on the other node. |
| `ha_vrrp_peer_addresses` | dict |  | `{}` | Map of group name to the peer's address. Overrides derivation. |
| `ha_vrrp_pair_group` | str |  | `''` | Inventory group containing exactly the two HA members. |
| `ha_vrrp_sync_group` | dict |  |  | Optional sync-group so all member groups fail over together. |
| `ha_vrrp_sync_group.name` | str | yes |  | Sync-group name. |
| `ha_vrrp_sync_group.members` | list | yes |  | VRRP group names in the sync-group. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync` | dict |  |  | Optional connection-tracking replication (docs section "NAT and conntrack-sync"). Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config because vyos.vyos has no resource module for it yet; the role only adds settings. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.interface` | str | yes |  | Interface used for replication traffic. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.sync_group` | str |  |  | Sync-group driving failover. Defaults to `ha_vrrp_sync_group.name`. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.accept_protocols` | list |  | `[tcp, udp, icmp]` | Protocols to replicate. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.mcast_group` | str |  |  | Multicast group. Ignored when a unicast peer is known. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.peer` | str |  |  | Unicast peer. Derived from the pair when omitted. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.sync_queue_size` | int |  |  | Sync queue size in MB. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.event_listen_queue_size` | int |  |  | Event listen queue size in MB. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync.disable_helpers` | bool |  | `false` | Disable all conntrack helper modules (`delete system conntrack modules`), as the HA page recommends. |
| `ha_vrrp_conntrack_sync_local_address` | str |  | `''` | This node's address on the conntrack-sync interface, used to derive the peer. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify` against both members in the same play. Checks every group is up on each node and that exactly one node is MASTER per group.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ha_vrrp_groups` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `ha_vrrp_pair_group` | str |  | `''` | Inventory group of the pair; enables the one-MASTER check. |
